name: Pâte Brisée
summary: Savoury short crust. Tender, no sugar, quiche and tart shells.

steps.text: Cut cold butter into the flour until sandy with pea-sized pieces.
Add ice water and bring together with as few strokes as possible.
Chill at least one hour before rolling.
Blind bake with weights before filling.

bake.notes: Freeze the shell for 15 minutes before blind baking to stop shrinkage.

notes: Overworking is the only way to ruin this.
